body_md:
# Literature Review

Drives the submission-5 problem-first literature review as DOCX, one section per
file, with every claim grounded in the candidate's curated per-paper critical
reviews. This is the default working mode of the ESGCIDBA Advisor.

## Overview

The literature review is written as an enterprise problem-solving argument:
state the problem, evidence it, explain its causes, locate where it concentrates,
examine the binding constraint, weigh the candidate remedy, set the measurement
frame, then synthesise into a conceptual model, research questions, and
hypotheses. The PRISMA and search-methodology section is drafted last so its
counts reconcile against the settled citation set.

## Prerequisites

* Python via `.venv\Scripts\python.exe`; `python-docx`, `PyMuPDF`, `pywin32` installed.
* Read `CLAUDE.md` and `.github/instructions/dba-house-style.instructions.md` first.
* Curated critical reviews available (for example on G:), and the Zotero MCP tools.

## Quick start

1. Clone the shared section template `.github/skills/_shared/assets/section-template.docx` into the submission output folder as the new section file. This preserves Times New Roman 12, 1.5 spacing, and the built-in Normal, Heading 1..5, and List Paragraph styles.
2. Build the citation map for the section from the reviews:
   `python .github/skills/literature-review/scripts/review_headers_extract.py "<reviews folder>" --out heads.txt`
3. Draft the section prose in the cloned file and use the document's built-in styles rather than per-run font overrides. Where a builder is preferred, run `docx_section_builder.py` (in `_shared/scripts/`).
4. Validate: `python .github/skills/_shared/scripts/docx_style_check.py <section.docx>`.
5. Update `/memories/repo/thesis-citation-tally.md` with new references.

## Section workflow

* One DOCX per section in the submission output folder; chapter title (Heading 1)
  only in the first file.
* Ground every citation in a reviewed paper. If a needed anchor is only found by
  citation searching inside a reviewed paper, add it to `new-cited-refs.docx`
  with its DOI and flag it for the candidate.
* Keep sentences at or under 30 words; split with `docx_sentence_splitter.py`.
* After candidate review, read `@Copilot` comments with `docx_comment_tools.py list`,
  implement, then `docx_comment_tools.py resolve`.
* Metrics on request: `docx_page_metrics.py` for page count and citation density.

## Citation tally and PRISMA

* Classify each reference: included study (search yield) or anchor (theory,
  method, or citation-searching find).
* Keep the provisional funnel delta current (anchors and reference-list totals).
* Only NEW anchors not present in the prior submission increment the anchor node.
* The pivot may drop previously included studies as out-of-scope; net those at
  the PRISMA step. Draft PRISMA last and regenerate the funnel as a new version.

## Script reference

| Script | Location | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `review_headers_extract.py` | `literature-review/scripts/` | Citation headers from review DOCX |
| `pdf_render_pages.py` | `literature-review/scripts/` | Rasterise scanned PDFs for vision OCR |
| `docx_page_metrics.py` | `literature-review/scripts/` | Page count + citation density |
| `new_cited_refs_table.py` | `literature-review/scripts/` | Append out-of-corpus references |
| `docx_section_builder.py` | `_shared/scripts/` | Build a section DOCX |
| `docx_style_check.py` | `_shared/scripts/` | House-style validation |
| `docx_sentence_splitter.py` | `_shared/scripts/` | In-place run-level edits |
| `docx_comment_tools.py` | `_shared/scripts/` | Read and resolve Word comments |
| `pdf_extract_text.py` | `_shared/scripts/` | PDF text extraction |

## Backup workflow

The `.claude/` markdown command library (`draft-lr-*`, `triage-rr-csv`,
`triage-consensus`, `triage-acm-bib`, `lit-summarise`, `integrate-lr`,
`audit-lr-refs`, `check-lr-plagiarism`) remains available. Use it only when the
candidate explicitly asks to switch to the markdown pipeline.

## Troubleshooting

* Style check fails on en dashes: check for numeric ranges (allowed) versus prose
  dashes (rewrite). The checker already excludes digit-flanked en dashes.
* `pdf_extract_text.py` returns near-zero characters: the PDF is scanned; use
  `pdf_render_pages.py` and read the images with a vision model.
* `docx_page_metrics.py` shows "estimated": Word COM (pywin32) or Word is not
  available; counts fall back to a word-count estimate.

## Attribution

Built for the ESGCIDBA-Thesis workspace from the submission-5 working method.
